notes: DeepFlux 7.9 - uncensored agent. The built-in AI agent now runs on an uncensored DeepSeek (Venice AI's deepseek-v4-1-flash-uncensored, private inference, 1M-token context) instead of the standard cloud model - out of the box, no account needed, on Windows, Linux and Android. Existing installs switch over automatically when they ride the built-in key; if you entered your own API key or picked a different provider, nothing changes. The Settings dialog no longer carries the built-in key across an endpoint switch, and the agent itself can no longer redirect the built-in key to another provider.
